title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Build and modernize client-facing applications using React, Node, and cloud-native services.
description: Tanvi IT is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Application Development & Modernization practice. You'll work directly with client teams to design, build, and modernize business-critical applications, pairing hands-on engineering with mentorship of junior consultants.
responsibilities: Design and build full-stack features across React/Next.js front ends and Node/Java back ends
Lead modernization of legacy applications to cloud-native architectures
Partner with client stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs
Mentor junior engineers and review code for quality and maintainability
requirements: 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong TypeScript/JavaScript and one back-end language (Java, C#, or Node)
Experience with AWS or Azure cloud services
Prior consulting or client-facing experience a plus

title: Data Analytics Consultant
summary: Turn raw data into decision-ready dashboards and insights for federal and commercial clients.
description: As a Data Analytics Consultant, you'll design data pipelines and BI dashboards that help our clients make faster, better-informed decisions, working across the full stack from data modeling to visualization.
responsibilities: Build and maintain ETL pipelines feeding client data warehouses
Design dashboards and reports in Power BI or Tableau
Partner with business stakeholders to define KPIs and metrics
Ensure data quality, governance, and documentation standards
requirements: 3+ years in data analytics, BI, or a related field
Proficiency in SQL and at least one BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
Experience with data warehousing concepts
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: DevOps Engineer
summary: Automate CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure for a portfolio of enterprise clients.
description: We're hiring a DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and operate CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure across multiple client engagements, with a focus on reliability, security, and speed of delivery.
responsibilities: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps
Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation
Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for production systems
Support containerization and orchestration efforts (Docker, Kubernetes)
requirements: 4+ years of DevOps or SRE experience
Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure
Working knowledge of Terraform and container orchestration
Scripting proficiency in Bash, Python, or PowerShell

title: QA Automation Engineer
summary: Design automated test frameworks that keep client releases fast and defect-free.
description: Join our IV&V and Automation Testing practice to build test automation frameworks and independent verification processes that give our clients confidence in every release.
responsibilities: Design and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, regression)
Perform independent verification & validation on client deliverables
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
Report defects and track quality metrics across releases
requirements: 3+ years in QA automation or IV&V
Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or similar frameworks
Familiarity with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured)
Strong attention to detail and documentation habits

title: Performance Test Engineer
summary: Load and stress-test enterprise systems to validate scalability before go-live.
description: We're looking for a Performance Test Engineer to plan and execute load, stress, and scalability testing for large enterprise systems, identifying bottlenecks before they reach production.
responsibilities: Design performance test plans aligned to client SLAs
Build and run load/stress tests using JMeter or LoadRunner
Analyze results and partner with engineering to resolve bottlenecks
Deliver performance reports and recommendations to stakeholders
requirements: 3+ years of performance/load testing experience
Proficiency with JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling
Understanding of application and database performance tuning
Ability to work independently on a contract basis

title: Enterprise Architect
summary: Shape target-state architectures and modernization roadmaps for enterprise clients.
description: As an Enterprise Architect, you'll lead the definition of current- and target-state architectures for our clients, guiding technology roadmaps that balance modernization, cost, and risk.
responsibilities: Develop enterprise architecture blueprints and modernization roadmaps
Advise clients on technology strategy and platform selection
Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes
Align solution designs with business objectives and compliance requirements
requirements: 8+ years in enterprise or solution architecture
Experience with TOGAF or similar architecture frameworks
Strong grasp of cloud, integration, and data architecture patterns
Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills

title: Cloud & AI Solutions Engineer
summary: Prototype and deliver AI-enabled solutions on modern cloud platforms for our clients.
description: Our Emerging Technologies group helps clients evaluate and adopt AI, automation, and next-generation cloud services. You'll prototype solutions, run proofs of concept, and help productionize what works.
responsibilities: Design and prototype AI/ML-enabled solutions for client use cases
Evaluate emerging cloud and platform services for fit and feasibility
Build proofs of concept and present findings to client stakeholders
Collaborate with delivery teams to productionize successful pilots
requirements: 4+ years of software engineering or applied ML experience
Familiarity with cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or similar)
Strong Python skills; comfort with rapid prototyping
Curiosity and ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences

title: Software Engineering Intern
summary: Get hands-on consulting experience building real client applications alongside senior engineers.
description: Our internship program pairs you with senior engineers on live client projects, giving you real-world experience across the software delivery lifecycle in a consulting environment.
responsibilities: Assist in building and testing features under senior engineer guidance
Participate in code reviews, standups, and sprint planning
Document technical work and contribute to internal knowledge base
Complete a capstone project presented at the end of the internship
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field
Coursework or project experience in at least one programming language
Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn
Available for a minimum 10-week commitment
